items.title: My column in @FortuneMagazine with John Greenwood on why US Treasury Sec. Bessent's intervention is DESTINED TO FAIL: "Sec. Bessent is engaged in “Operation Twist” to try to control the yield curve and keep the long-bond prices higher and the yields lower. It can only succeed if monetary growth is supportive of his action. During the first half of 2026, broad money has been growing at nearly double-digit rates. This fact will torpedo Bessent’s interventions, making them pointless."
